1879060904.name: Minor Ballad
1879060904.desc: Boosts Tactical damage and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879093928.name: Possum Impersonation
1879093928.desc: Middle-earth is a dangerous place. Sometimes it is good to be dead.

1879096872.name: Scribe Manual: Moor Cowbell
1879096872.desc: This will scribe a manual to teach others to play Moor cowbell. Doing so is much more taxing than training in person and requires a Blank Mentor Manual.

1879097896.name: Hatchlings
1879097896.desc: You summon one of your brood to aid you in battle.

1879109288.name: Mending Verse
1879109288.desc: Hardships are forgotten and spirits are lifted by such writings. This heal over time stacks with itself. -1% Power cost per Healing Attunement.

1879157288.name: Soldier
1879157288.desc: Call upon your Soldier to assist you in battle.\n<rgb=#FF0000>Can only be used inside of a Skirmish, while out of combat.</rgb>

1879159976.name: Springfest Horse
1879159976.desc: A horse from the Spring Festival.

1879205928.name: Galadhrim Pony
1879205928.desc: The Galadhrim have chosen to honour you with one of their prized ponies.

1879230632.name: Eye Gouge
1879230632.desc: A swift swipe meant for the eyes.   <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879238952.name: Simbelmynë Pony
1879238952.desc: A pony from the Spring Festival.

1879241640.name: Anthem of the Riddermark
1879241640.desc: Your music culminates in a great Anthem that reveres the land of Rohan, the Riddermark.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Alters Coda: Your next Coda will increase mitigations for you, nearby fellowship members and war-steeds.</rgb>

1879270312.name: Recklessness
1879270312.desc: Sacrifice defence in favour of an all-out assault, improving your offence for a short time.

1879274792.name: Improved Merciful Shot
1879274792.desc: A massively damaging shot that unlocks when the target is below 70% health.\n\nCritical hits deal bonus damage.

1879284904.name: Banner - Engineer
1879284904.desc: Place a banner that improves Engineers.

1879291048.name: Beacon of Hope
1879291048.desc: Transfers Morale to your allies and companions.

1879314472.name: Treasure-seeking Cave-claw
1879314472.desc: Summons a treasure-seeking cave-claw to help you search for riches!

1879316904.name: Bake a Honey-cake
1879316904.desc: Bake a Honey-cake for yourself or a friend!

1879360808.name: Toxic Frogling
1879360808.desc: Brings out a toxic frogling to keep you company.

1879386024.name: Black Rabbit
1879386024.desc: Brings out a black rabbit to keep you company.

1879388584.name: Topaz Neekerbreeker
1879388584.desc: Brings out a topaz Neekerbreeker to keep you company.

1879420328.name: Share Innate Strength: Balance
1879420328.desc:
Bolster your fellowship and raid members with a portion of your Innate Strength: Balance.
<rgb=#FF0000>Requires a Tier 4 Innate Strength: Balance buff to be present on the Brawler.</rgb>

<rgb=#00FF00>If Specialized as The Fulcrum, all Fellowship and Raid Members within 15m gain: 
Increased Parry Chance

If specialized as The Maelstrom, all Fellowship and Raid Members within 15m gain:
Increased Finesse</rgb>

1879445160.name: Return to Tornhad
1879445160.desc: You're able to quickly return to Tornhad. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879465512.name: Albino Jerboa
1879465512.desc: Summons a friendly jerboa to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466280.name: Smoking Stones
1879466280.desc: The stones in this phial crackle and vibrate with energy. Exposing them to air will unleash their full potential.

1879467816.name: Thorned Armour
1879467816.desc: You call on natural defences to absorb and redirect some of your enemies' attacks back on themselves.

1879468840.name: War-steed: Heavy
1879468840.desc: The Destrier is a heavily armoured War-steed. Stalwart and imposing, The Destrier is bred for battle. The least agile and slowest of the war-steeds trades speed and maneuverability.

1879480616.name: Turquoise Snake
1879480616.desc: Summons a snake to accompany you on your travels.

1879485992.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Flame-beak Caller)
1879485992.desc: Summons a raven-type companion.\n\nThe flame-beak caller specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879491496.name: Sail to Maurûsh
1879491496.desc: Navigate to Ub Nishir, near Maurûsh in Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley with nearby fellows.

1879506600.name: Prepared: Wisp of Frost
1879506600.desc: Gelid Wind adherents deal frost damage swiftly.

1879508008.name: Blasting Arrow
1879508008.desc: Launch an arrow loaded with fireworks into the air, dazing enemies at close range.
